mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT order_no AS orderNo, member_no AS memberNo, orderer_name AS ordererName, order_status AS orderStatus, total_price AS totalPrice, created_at AS createdAt FROM orders WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM ( SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.member_no AS memberNo, o.orderer_name AS ordererName, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.total_price AS totalPrice, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone_number AS receiverPhoneNumber, o.receiver_zip_code AS receiverZipCode, o.receiver_base_address AS receiverBaseAddress, o.receiver_detail_address AS receiverDetailAddress, o.message, (SELECT oi.item_name FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_no = o.order_no AND ROWNUM = 1) AS first_item_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi2 WHERE oi2.order_no = o.order_no) AS item_count FROM orders o WHERE o.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum > #{startRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
